data.script: Erik: Word Games final! Sofia, spell the word GARDEN. … Sofia: G-A-R-D-E-N. Garden! … Erik: Ten points! Now: the opposite of EMPTY. … Sofia: Full! … Erik: Correct! Name three animals that can swim. … Sofia: Dolphin, penguin and… Luna! … Erik: Ha! We accept it. Last question: how many letters are in CROCODILE? … Sofia: C-R-O-C-O-D-I-L-E… nine! … Erik: Champion! The golden pencil is yours!
